publicDataTerms.scope: The compact source projection is an adaptation of Seshat Public Data and is distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution, a license link, and an indication that the projection and local mappings are changes.

attribution: This case uses data from the Seshat Databank (https://seshat-db.com) under CC BY-SA 4.0. Onto2D selected three Road records, produced a compact projection, added explicit local reference mappings, and derived support graphs and ablation outputs.
